## Objective
- Build a complete, playable desktop 2D pixel-art turn-based RPG inspired by Chrono Trigger and Sea of Stars, with epic attack effects, based on the linked issue.

## Requirements
- “Build a complete, playable game now”; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built an original browser-based RPG prototype titled **STARFALL — The Last Hour**, using a custom canvas scene and turn-based battle mechanics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the game’s layout, responsive styling, HUD, and canvas.
- Created `game.js` with pixel-art scene rendering, party/enemy sprites, RPG battle mechanics, skills, items, timed attacks/parries, and effects.

### Active
- Finish and validate `game.js`; add remaining turn-flow and initialization/input logic.
- Run the game and check it in-browser, fixing any issues and capturing a latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- `game.js` currently ends after `renderParty()` and lacks enemy turns, game start/win/loss flow, keyboard/canvas handlers, and the animation loop, so the game is not yet playable.
- No validation or browser screenshot has been successfully performed.

## Next Move
1. Continue `game.js` with enemy-turn resolution, game initialization/restart, win/loss states, keyboard and canvas input, and `requestAnimationFrame` loop.
2. Run a JavaScript syntax check and launch the game in a browser.
3. Exercise the start flow and battle actions; fix issues and save/inspect a current JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results for the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and presentation; loads `game.js`.
- `game.js`: Canvas graphics and partial combat logic; needs completion.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable desktop 2D pixel-art turn-based RPG inspired by Chrono Trigger and Sea of Stars, based on the linked issue.

## Requirements
- Work without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The game is an original browser RPG titled **STARFALL — The Last Hour**, with a custom pixel-art canvas scene and turn-based battles.
- `game.js` was replaced with a complete implementation of the game flow and battle logic.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html` provides the game shell, styling, HUD, canvas, and script reference.
- `game.js` includes the canvas scene, party and enemy rendering, command menus, attacks and skills, items, timed strikes and parries, enemy turns, win/loss states, restart flow, keyboard/mouse input, and animation loop.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser smoke test confirmed start, skills/target selection, timed attack, enemy response/parry flow, and next hero turn; no JavaScript page errors observed.
- Saved a JPEG screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg` (1280px viewport); visual inspection remains pending.

### Active
- Inspect the latest screenshot and continue testing battle actions, win/loss, and restart flows.

### Blocked
- Browser check logged a resource 404: `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)`; source not identified.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/latest.jpg`.
2. Identify and resolve the browser resource 404 if it is caused by the project.
3. Exercise items, guard, battle win/loss, and restart flows; fix issues and rerun checks.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game rendering, battle logic, state flow, and input handling.
- `index.html`: Game shell and presentation.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Latest browser smoke-test screenshot.

## Important Context
- User’s issue URL: `https://omgithub.com/bielxv/PlayGround/issues/1`.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear untracked in `git status`.
